About_&_Key_Points:
About
Incorporated in 2020, Borana Weaves Limited is a manufacturer of unbleached synthetic grey fabric based in Surat, Gujarat.
[1]
Key Points
Business Profile:
[1]
The company manufactures unbleached synthetic grey fabric, used for further the
processing like dyeing and printing across various segments such as fashion, traditional textiles, technical textiles, home décor, and interior design. It also produces polyester textured yarn, which is primarily used in-
house for grey fabric manufacturing.
